title: Majority Fourier tail estimate
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be odd natural numbers with $2k^2 \\le n$. The Fourier weight of majority on subsets of size greater than $k$, divided by $(2/\\pi)^{3/2}k^{-1/2}$, differs from $1$ by at most $5/k$ in absolute value.
